scope: All ordinary body-flow citations, their nearby substantive claims, primary metadata and passages, bibliography coverage, the canonical bibliography, and the complete publication source-file dependency set were checked.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage frozen claim extraction followed by claim-by-claim primary-source verification using official arXiv and Preprints.org text, the author-hosted published Arb paper, DOI metadata, and final LaTeX/BibTeX consistency checks.
